name: Data Analyzer: A new saved validation program starts with sensible default values
objective: Proves that optional properties of a saved validation program (use count, status, rule counts, last-used date, AI model name) get the correct starting values when not supplied.
precondition: Offline test harness; no database, network or AI model is used.

steps.action: Create a validation program record supplying only the required properties.
steps.data: Made-up program with id test-123, name TestProgram, source test.csv, no aliases, no rules
steps.expected: The record is created without error.

steps.action: Read the optional properties.
steps.expected: Use count is 0, status is active, field count / basic-rule count / logic-rule count are all 0, last-used date is empty, and the AI model name is gpt-5-nano.

name: Data Analyzer: A saved validation program can be converted to a plain record for storage
objective: Proves that converting a program to a plain key/value record keeps its identifying details and turns the creation date into text.
precondition: Offline test harness; no database, network or AI model is used.

steps.action: Convert the sample program to a plain record.
steps.data: One made-up saved program (name 20241202-143022-TestProgram, source test_dict.csv, REDCap CSV format, one field)
steps.expected: The record holds the same program id (test-uuid-1234), name, one alias (testAlias1), source file, dictionary fingerprint (hash), format, creator (testuser) and status (active).

steps.action: Check the creation date.
steps.expected: The creation date in the record is text rather than a date object.

name: Data Analyzer: A validation program can be rebuilt from stored values
objective: Proves that a program record can be constructed from stored values (including a text date turned back into a real date) and keeps every value. This exercises the record's constructor; the product has no dedicated 'load from record' function.
precondition: Offline test harness; no database, network or AI model is used.

steps.action: Build a program from a made-up stored record, converting the creation date text into a date.
steps.data: Made-up record: id test-uuid-5678, two aliases, FHIR JSON format, 2 fields, 5 basic rules, 2 logic rules, use count 3
steps.expected: The program has the same id, name, two aliases, use count 3, field count 2, basic-rule count 5 and logic-rule count 2.

steps.action: Check the creation date.
steps.expected: The creation date is a real date value.

name: Data Analyzer: Opening the program database creates the three expected tables
objective: Proves that a new program database is set up with places to store programs, their nicknames (aliases) and their run history.
precondition: Offline test harness; a brand-new empty program database is created in a temporary folder for this test and discarded afterwards. No network and no AI model.

steps.action: Open a new program database, then inspect the tables it contains.
steps.expected: Tables named programs, aliases and execution_history all exist.

name: Data Analyzer: Program database uses the safer multi-user write mode
objective: Proves that the database is switched to write-ahead logging (WAL), a setting that lets several users read and write at the same time.
precondition: Offline test harness; a brand-new empty program database is created in a temporary folder for this test and discarded afterwards. No network and no AI model.

steps.action: Open a new program database, then ask the database engine which journal mode it is using.
steps.expected: The journal mode is WAL.

name: Data Analyzer: Opening the program database keeps a programs folder available
objective: Proves that the folder used to hold program files exists after the database is opened.
precondition: Offline test harness; a brand-new empty program database is created in a temporary folder for this test and discarded afterwards. No network and no AI model. The temporary folder already contains an empty programs folder.

steps.action: Open the program database in the temporary folder.
steps.data: Temporary folder with a programs subfolder
steps.expected: A programs folder exists and is a folder. (The folder was already created by the test set-up, so this does not prove the product creates it from nothing.)

name: Data Analyzer: A saved program can be loaded back by its id
objective: Proves that a program saved to the database comes back with the same details when requested by its id.
precondition: Offline test harness; a brand-new empty program database is created in a temporary folder for this test and discarded afterwards. No network and no AI model.

steps.action: Save the sample program.
steps.data: One made-up saved program (name 20241202-143022-TestProgram, source test_dict.csv, REDCap CSV format, one field)
steps.expected: The save reports success (True).

steps.action: Load the program using its id.
steps.expected: A program is returned with the same id, name, dictionary hash, generated code and field count.

name: Data Analyzer: A saved program can be loaded back by its name
objective: Proves a program can be found by its full name as well as its id.
precondition: Offline test harness; a brand-new empty program database is created in a temporary folder for this test and discarded afterwards. No network and no AI model.

steps.action: Save the sample program, then load it using its name.
steps.expected: The program returned has the same id and name as the one saved.

name: Data Analyzer: A saved program can be loaded back by a nickname (alias)
objective: Proves that a nickname given to a program can be used to find it.
precondition: Offline test harness; a brand-new empty program database is created in a temporary folder for this test and discarded afterwards. No network and no AI model.

steps.action: Save the sample program and give it the nickname myTestAlias.
steps.expected: The nickname is created.

steps.action: Load the program using the nickname.
steps.expected: The program returned is the same program (same id).

name: Data Analyzer: Asking for a program that does not exist returns nothing
objective: Proves that looking up an unknown program gives an empty answer rather than an error or a wrong program.
precondition: Offline test harness; a brand-new empty program database is created in a temporary folder for this test and discarded afterwards. No network and no AI model.

steps.action: Load a program using an id that was never saved.
steps.expected: The result is empty (None).

name: Data Analyzer: Programs can be found by the fingerprint of their data dictionary
objective: Proves that a saved program is found when searching by the fingerprint (hash) of the data dictionary it was built from.
precondition: Offline test harness; a brand-new empty program database is created in a temporary folder for this test and discarded afterwards. No network and no AI model.

steps.action: Save the sample program, then search by its dictionary hash.
steps.expected: Exactly one program is found and it is the saved one.

name: Data Analyzer: Programs can be found by the name of their dictionary file
objective: Proves that when two programs are saved, searching by source file name returns only the matching one. Note: despite its title this test searches by source file name (test2.json), not by format, because the format filter is not what is exercised.
precondition: Offline test harness; a brand-new empty program database is created in a temporary folder for this test and discarded afterwards. No network and no AI model.

steps.action: Save two made-up programs: one from test1.csv (REDCap CSV) and one from test2.json (FHIR JSON).
steps.data: Two programs, ids prog1 and prog2
steps.expected: Both saves succeed.

steps.action: Search by source file name.
steps.expected: Exactly one program is returned and it is prog2.

name: Data Analyzer: Deleted programs no longer appear in search results
objective: Proves that after a program is deleted by an administrator, a general search does not list it.
precondition: Offline test harness; temporary empty program database; the administrator password is set to a made-up value for this test.

steps.action: Save the sample program, then delete it using the correct administrator password.
steps.data: Admin password: the made-up value set up by the test
steps.expected: The deletion is carried out.

steps.action: Search for all programs with no filter.
steps.expected: The deleted program's id is not among the results.

name: Data Analyzer: Listing all programs returns the most recently used first and never-used last
objective: Proves the list order: most recently used first, programs never used last. Use count plays no part (the product orders by last-used date; the old test title wrongly said use count and only counted results).
precondition: Offline test harness; a brand-new empty program database is created in a temporary folder for this test and discarded afterwards. No network and no AI model.

steps.action: Save three made-up programs, then list all programs
steps.data: LowUsage (used Jan 2024), MediumUsage (used Jun 2024), HighUsage (use count 10 but never used)
steps.expected: The order is MediumUsage, LowUsage, HighUsage.

name: Data Analyzer: A new nickname can be created for a program
objective: Proves that a nickname can be attached to a saved program and then used to find it.
precondition: Offline test harness; a brand-new empty program database is created in a temporary folder for this test and discarded afterwards. No network and no AI model.

steps.action: Save the sample program and create the nickname newAlias.
steps.expected: Creation reports success (True).

steps.action: Load the program by that nickname.
steps.expected: The same program is returned.

name: Data Analyzer: The same nickname cannot be used twice
objective: Proves that a nickname already in use is refused, so one nickname cannot point at two programs by accident.
precondition: Offline test harness; a brand-new empty program database is created in a temporary folder for this test and discarded afterwards. No network and no AI model.

steps.action: Create the nickname uniqueAlias for the sample program.
steps.expected: Reports success (True).

steps.action: Try to create the same nickname again.
steps.expected: Reports failure (False).

name: Data Analyzer: A nickname cannot be created for a program that does not exist
objective: Proves that attaching a nickname to an unknown program is refused.
precondition: Offline test harness; a brand-new empty program database is created in a temporary folder for this test and discarded afterwards. No network and no AI model.

steps.action: Try to create a nickname for a program id that was never saved.
steps.expected: Reports failure (False).

name: Data Analyzer: A nickname can be removed and then stops working
objective: Proves that deleting a nickname succeeds and that the program can no longer be found by it.
precondition: Offline test harness; a brand-new empty program database is created in a temporary folder for this test and discarded afterwards. No network and no AI model.

steps.action: Save the sample program, create nickname tempAlias, and confirm it finds the program.
steps.expected: The program is found by the nickname.

steps.action: Delete the nickname, then try to load by it again.
steps.expected: Deletion reports success (True) and the later lookup returns nothing.

name: Data Analyzer: Removing a nickname that does not exist is reported as a failure
objective: Proves that deleting an unknown nickname gives a clear negative answer.
precondition: Offline test harness; a brand-new empty program database is created in a temporary folder for this test and discarded afterwards. No network and no AI model.

steps.action: Delete a nickname that was never created.
steps.expected: Reports failure (False).

name: Data Analyzer: Each use of a program raises its use counter by one
objective: Proves that the counter showing how often a program has been used starts at 0 and goes up by one each time.
precondition: Offline test harness; a brand-new empty program database is created in a temporary folder for this test and discarded afterwards. No network and no AI model.

steps.action: Save the sample program and read its use count.
steps.expected: Use count is 0.

steps.action: Record one use, then another, reloading the program each time.
steps.expected: Use count is 1 after the first and 2 after the second.

name: Data Analyzer: A run of a program is written to the run history
objective: Proves that recording a run creates an entry in the run history for that program. It checks that a row exists, not what values it holds.
precondition: Offline test harness; a brand-new empty program database is created in a temporary folder for this test and discarded afterwards. No network and no AI model.

steps.action: Save the sample program and record one run with statistics
steps.data: User testuser, file test_data.csv, 100 rows, 3 field violations, 2 logic violations, 2.5 seconds
steps.expected: The call succeeds.

steps.action: Read the run history
steps.expected: Exactly one row exists carrying the same user, file, row count, both violation counts and the time.

name: Data Analyzer: Deleting a program with a wrong administrator password is refused
objective: Proves that only someone with the administrator password can delete a program.
precondition: Offline test harness; temporary empty program database; administrator password set to a made-up value.

steps.action: Try to delete the sample program using an incorrect password.
steps.expected: The system raises a permission error (PermissionError) whose message says 'Invalid admin password'.

name: Data Analyzer: A program is deleted (marked deleted) when the correct password is given
objective: Proves that an administrator can delete a program, and that it is kept in the database but marked as deleted rather than erased.
precondition: Offline test harness; temporary empty program database; administrator password set to a made-up value.

steps.action: Delete the sample program using the correct administrator password.
steps.expected: Deletion reports success (True).

steps.action: Read the program's status straight from the database.
steps.expected: A record still exists and its status is 'deleted'.

name: Data Analyzer: Deleting an unknown program is reported as a failure
objective: Proves that attempting to delete a program that does not exist gives a negative answer instead of an error.
precondition: Offline test harness; temporary empty program database; administrator password set to a made-up value.

steps.action: Delete a program id that was never saved, with the correct password.
steps.expected: Reports failure (False).

name: Data Analyzer: A deleted program can be restored by an administrator
objective: Proves that a program marked deleted can be brought back to active status with the correct password.
precondition: Offline test harness; temporary empty program database; administrator password set to a made-up value.

steps.action: Save and then delete the sample program.
steps.expected: The program is marked deleted.

steps.action: Restore the program with the correct password, then read its status from the database.
steps.expected: Restore reports success (True) and the stored status is 'active'.

name: Data Analyzer: Restoring a program with a wrong password is refused
objective: Proves that restoring a deleted program also requires the administrator password.
precondition: Offline test harness; temporary empty program database; administrator password set to a made-up value.

steps.action: Save and delete the sample program using the correct password, then try to restore it with a wrong password.
steps.expected: A permission error (PermissionError) is raised with the message 'Invalid admin password'.

name: Data Analyzer: The administrator password is read from the DATA_ANALYZER_ADMIN_PASSWORD setting
objective: Proves that the password check accepts the password configured in the DATA_ANALYZER_ADMIN_PASSWORD environment setting and rejects any other.
precondition: Offline test harness; DATA_ANALYZER_ADMIN_PASSWORD is set to a made-up value for this test.

steps.action: Check the configured password and an incorrect one.
steps.expected: The correct password is accepted (True); the incorrect one is rejected (False).

name: Data Analyzer: Auto-generated program names start with a date and time
objective: Proves that a program name begins with an eight-digit date, a dash, a six-digit time and another dash.
precondition: Offline test harness; no database, network or AI model is used.

steps.action: Generate a name for a made-up dictionary with fields patient_id and diagnosis.
steps.expected: Characters 1-8 are digits, character 9 is a dash, characters 10-15 are digits and character 16 is a dash. The descriptive part after that is not checked.

name: Data Analyzer: A clinical-looking dictionary is labelled ClinicalData
objective: Proves that when field names suggest clinical research, the program description is ClinicalData.
precondition: Offline test harness; no database, network or AI model is used.

steps.action: Generate a description for a dictionary with clinical field names.
steps.expected: The description is exactly 'ClinicalData'.

name: Data Analyzer: A staff-record dictionary is labelled EmployeeData
objective: Proves that when field names suggest employee records, the program description is EmployeeData.
precondition: Offline test harness; no database, network or AI model is used.

steps.action: Generate a description for a dictionary with employee field names.
steps.expected: The description is exactly 'EmployeeData'.

name: Data Analyzer: An unrecognised dictionary gets a generic label
objective: Proves that when no domain is recognised, the description falls back to DataValidation.
precondition: Offline test harness; no database, network or AI model is used.

steps.action: Generate a description for a dictionary with neutral field names.
steps.expected: The description is exactly 'DataValidation'.

name: Data Analyzer: REDCap data dictionaries are recognised
objective: Proves that text with the REDCap column headings is identified as REDCap CSV.
precondition: Offline test harness; no database, network or AI model is used.

steps.action: Detect the format of a made-up dictionary starting with 'Variable / Field Name,Form Name,Field Type,Field Label'.
steps.expected: The format is 'REDCap CSV'.

name: Data Analyzer: FHIR questionnaires are recognised
objective: Proves that JSON text declaring a FHIR Questionnaire is identified as FHIR JSON.
precondition: Offline test harness; no database, network or AI model is used.

steps.action: Detect the format of a made-up FHIR Questionnaire.
steps.expected: The format is 'FHIR JSON'.

name: Data Analyzer: Other JSON content is recognised as generic JSON
objective: Proves that JSON that is not a FHIR Questionnaire is labelled plain JSON.
precondition: Offline test harness; no database, network or AI model is used.

steps.action: Detect the format of a made-up JSON document.
steps.expected: The format is 'JSON'.

name: Data Analyzer: Unrecognised content is treated as CSV
objective: Proves that text matching no known format falls back to CSV.
precondition: Offline test harness; no database, network or AI model is used.

steps.action: Detect the format of arbitrary text.
steps.data: The sentence 'random content that doesn't match any pattern'
steps.expected: The format is 'CSV'.

name: Data Analyzer: Special characters are removed from program names
objective: Proves that punctuation and spaces are stripped from a name while letters and digits survive.
precondition: Offline test harness; no database, network or AI model is used.

steps.action: Clean the name 'My Test@Program#2024!'.
steps.expected: The result contains no @, #, ! or space, and still contains 'Test' (or 'test') and '2024'.

name: Data Analyzer: Program names are limited to 30 characters
objective: Proves that very long names are shortened.
precondition: Offline test harness; no database, network or AI model is used.

steps.action: Clean a name made of 50 letter A's.
steps.expected: The result is 30 characters or fewer.

name: Data Analyzer: Plain letters and digits in a name are left unchanged
objective: Proves that cleaning does not alter an already-clean name.
precondition: Offline test harness; no database, network or AI model is used.

steps.action: Clean the name 'Test123Program'.
steps.expected: The result is exactly 'Test123Program'.

name: Data Analyzer: Program manager starts in limited mode when the AI client cannot start
objective: Proves that when no AI client is supplied and the parser refuses to start (no credentials), the manager is still created with no AI client and keeps its database. The parser and database are stand-ins, so the result does not depend on this machine's settings.
precondition: Offline test harness; the AI parser and the database class are replaced by stand-ins. No real database, network or AI model.

steps.action: Create the program manager with no AI client while the parser raises a 'not configured' error
steps.expected: No error; the manager's AI client is empty and its database is the stand-in.

name: Data Analyzer: Running a saved program returns its results and records the run
objective: Proves running a saved program on a small table succeeds: no error entry, the right program, an empty violation list, a summary with the right row count, and one row in the run history.
precondition: Offline test harness; a brand-new empty program database is created in a temporary folder for this test and discarded afterwards. No network and no AI model. The program manager is built without an AI client.

steps.action: Save the sample program, then run it on a made-up 3-row table
steps.expected: No 'error' entry; program id test-uuid-1234; no logic violations; summary says 3 rows processed; one run-history row with 3 rows processed.

name: Data Analyzer: One run of a saved program adds exactly one to its use count (known product bug: adds two)
objective: Proves one run raises the program's use count by one. Currently expected to fail (marked xfail, strict): running a program records the use twice, so the count goes up by two. Remove the xfail marker when the product is fixed.
precondition: Offline test harness; a brand-new empty program database is created in a temporary folder for this test and discarded afterwards. No network and no AI model. The program manager is built without an AI client.

steps.action: Save the sample program, run it once on a made-up 3-row table
steps.expected: Expected: use count 1. Actual today: 2, so the test is an expected failure.

name: Data Analyzer: Running a program that does not exist reports 'program_not_found'
objective: Proves that asking to run an unknown program returns a clear error rather than failing.
precondition: Offline test harness; a brand-new empty program database is created in a temporary folder for this test and discarded afterwards. No network and no AI model. The program manager is built without an AI client.

steps.action: Run a program id that was never saved on a made-up 3-row table.
steps.expected: The result is a dictionary whose error value is 'program_not_found'.

name: Data Analyzer: Running a deleted program is refused
objective: Proves that a program an administrator has deleted cannot be run.
precondition: Offline test harness; temporary empty program database; made-up administrator password; program manager built without an AI client.

steps.action: Save the sample program, delete it, then try to run it on a made-up 3-row table.
steps.expected: The result is an error entry whose value is either 'program_deleted' or 'program_not_found' (either is accepted).

name: Data Analyzer: Full life of a program: save, nickname, use, record run, delete, restore
objective: Proves the main database steps work together in order and the program ends up active again with its usage recorded.
precondition: Offline test harness; temporary empty program database; made-up administrator password.

steps.action: Save a made-up program, give it the nickname workflowAlias, and load it by that nickname.
steps.expected: Each step succeeds and the nickname finds the same program.

steps.action: Record one use and one run (100 rows, no problems found), then reload.
steps.expected: Use count is 1.

steps.action: Delete the program with the correct password and read its stored status.
steps.expected: Deletion succeeds and the stored status is 'deleted'.

steps.action: Restore it with the correct password and load it again.
steps.expected: Restore succeeds; the program loads with status 'active' and a use count of at least 1.

name: Data Analyzer: One program can have several nicknames
objective: Proves that three different nicknames can be attached to the same program and each finds it.
precondition: Offline test harness; a brand-new empty program database is created in a temporary folder for this test and discarded afterwards. No network and no AI model.

steps.action: Save the sample program and create nicknames alias1, alias2 and alias3.
steps.expected: All three creations succeed.

steps.action: Load the program by each nickname.
steps.expected: Each lookup returns the same program id.

name: Data Analyzer: A program can be found again by its dictionary fingerprint
objective: Proves that a program saved with a dictionary fingerprint is found by searching for that fingerprint (the way a repeat upload of the same dictionary is matched).
precondition: Offline test harness; a brand-new empty program database is created in a temporary folder for this test and discarded afterwards. No network and no AI model.

steps.action: Save a made-up program with fingerprint unique-hash-12345 and search for that fingerprint.
steps.expected: Exactly one program is returned, with that hash and the id hash-test-1.

name: Data Analyzer: Ten uses made at the same time give a use count of ten
objective: Proves the use counter does not lose updates when ten uses are recorded at the same moment from ten threads (previously they were made one after another).
precondition: Offline test harness; a brand-new empty program database is created in a temporary folder for this test and discarded afterwards. No network and no AI model.

steps.action: Save the sample program, record ten uses from ten threads, then reload it
steps.expected: Use count is exactly 10.

name: Data Analyzer: Several program runs are all kept in the run history
objective: Proves that three separately recorded runs are all stored for the program.
precondition: Offline test harness; a brand-new empty program database is created in a temporary folder for this test and discarded afterwards. No network and no AI model.

steps.action: Save the sample program and record three runs by users user1, user2 and user3.
steps.expected: All three recordings are accepted.

steps.action: Count the run-history rows for this program.
steps.expected: The count is exactly 3.

name: Data Analyzer: With no administrator password configured, every password attempt is refused
objective: Proves there is no built-in default administrator password: when none is configured, no attempt (including the former default, a wrong one or a blank one) is accepted.
precondition: Offline test harness; both administrator-password settings (the documented DATA_ANALYZER_ADMIN_PASSWORD and the old ADMIN_PW) are removed for this test.

steps.action: Check three password attempts against the program database's admin check.
steps.data: The former built-in default password text, 'wrong-password', and an empty text
steps.expected: All three are rejected (False).
